name: Website Uptime & Incident Notifier | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Website Uptime & Incident Notifier
Every 5 minutes checks each site (optionally that a word appears on the page). After `confirmFailures` failed checks in a row it emails a DOWN alert and logs an incident; when the site is back it emails a RECOVERED notice with the downtime.
1. Fill in **Settings** (one site per line, `https://site.com | text that must appear` is optional). 2. Make a sheet with an **Incidents** tab (`uptime-incidents-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail. 4. Activate.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Fill in these values before activating.
